test_title: PYST 56: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 09 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following major events followed the death of Potti Sreeramulu?

options.text: Appointment of the States Reorganisation Commission

solution:
The correct answer is __**Appointment of the States Reorganisation Commission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Potti Sreeramulu, a freedom fighter, fasted to death in 1952 to demand the creation of a separate state for Telugu-speaking people, which resulted in the formation of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• His death caused widespread protests and unrest, leading the government to consider the linguistic reorganization of states in India.
 
• In December 1953, the Indian government appointed the **States Reorganisation Commission** to examine the issues of reorganization of states based on linguistic and cultural factors.
 
• The commission, chaired by Justice Fazal Ali, submitted its report in 1955, which recommended the reorganization of states along linguistic lines.
 
• The recommendations of the commission led to the passage of the **States Reorganisation Act, 1956**, which established new states and reorganized the boundaries of existing ones.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Creation of Linguistic Minorities Commission**:

 
 
• The creation of the Linguistic Minorities Commission was not directly linked to Potti Sreeramulu's death.
 
• It was established in 1957 under Article 350B of the Indian Constitution to safeguard the interests of linguistic minorities.
 
• The commission works to ensure the rights and privileges of linguistic minorities in India and to promote their integration into the country's socio-economic framework.
 
 
 
• **Formation of the Planning Commission**:
 
 
• The Planning Commission was established earlier, in 1950, by Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru to oversee the economic development of India through five-year plans.
 
• It was not related to the events following the death of Potti Sreeramulu.
 
• Its primary objective was to promote sustainable economic growth and improve the standard of living in India.
 
 
 
• **Formation of the Election Commission**:
 
 
• The Election Commission of India was established in 1950 under Article 324 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It is responsible for conducting free and fair elections in the country, including Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, and state legislative assemblies.
 
• Its creation was unrelated to Potti Sreeramulu's death.
